purpose: Provide an explicit machine-verifiable proof that the canonical taste checkpoint requirement has been satisfied before any downstream content, Store or SteamDB stage begins.

allowed_only_if_all: full fingerprint validation is complete for every current candidate
final taste ledger is complete and bound to the same taste index and fingerprint validation
no recovery artifact is present that requires a merge
no semantic miss evaluation occurred because there were no misses
no false-negative audit change occurred because there were no fresh exclusions to audit
the canonical taste cache blob is exactly the blob attested by the current compact taste index
zero_write_fast_path.meaning: There are provably zero new or changed final non-borderline taste entries to persist, so zero GitHub writes is a completed mandatory checkpoint rather than a skipped checkpoint.

accept_only_if_all: taste_index_blob_sha equals stage 04 taste index SHA
ledger_validation_blob_sha equals stage 10 ledger validation SHA
